interface.shortDescription: Value-aware photo refinement with a simplified creative control surface
interface.longDescription: Configure Photo Refiner v2.2 through a simplified creative workspace before generation. The default surface focuses on look, style strength, delivery mode, and output size while adaptive high-resolution recovery, identity protection, and value-aware patch planning stay automatic. Professional controls remain available for grading, portrait retouching, reshaping, clothing cleanup, background refinement, detail scope, and batch consistency.
